name: pickup-ready-card
title: Pickup ready card
description: Your order is ready to collect: a large pickup code with copy and a QR slot, the shop, today's hours, what to bring and how long it is held.
docs: Pass order, code, store ({ name, address: string[], phone }), hours (today's opening hours in words), heldUntil, bring (a list; it defaults to a photo ID and the code), directionsHref and, for shops that scan, qr: a QR code from your own library, drawn in a white box so it reads in the dark theme too. heldUntil is a date such as '2026-10-30', which holds the order through the end of that day in timeZone, or a date-time, which holds it until then; it is written as a <time> element. Once it has passed the card says 'Pickup window ended', takes the code out of use, drops the copy button and the QR code and shows a contact line with the shop's number as a tel: link, and a polite status says so once. Pass now from the server for a first render that matches the browser's; without it the browser's clock is read after the page has loaded and again when the tab comes back or a minute passes. The code is plain selectable text and is read out one character at a time. The shop and the hours sit beside their words once the card is wide enough and under them in a narrow column. onCopy receives the code. locale, timeZone, headingAs and labels do the usual.
